# edgecase

> High-performance graph analysis library

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Classes
> Core classes and types

- [Graph](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/Graph.html): A high-performance graph data structure with optional direction and weights
- [GraphWidget](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/GraphWidget.html): Interactive graph visualization widget for Jupyter notebooks

#### Functions
> Public functions

- [list_palettes](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/list_palettes.html): List available color palettes, optionally filtered by category
- [ca_grqc](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/ca_grqc.html): Arxiv GR-QC (General Relativity and Quantum Cosmology) collaboration network
- [celegans](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/celegans.html): C. Elegans metabolic network
- [condmat](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/condmat.html): Condensed Matter Physics collaboration network
- [dolphins](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/dolphins.html): Dolphin social network
- [enron](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/enron.html): Enron email communication network
- [football](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/football.html): American college football network
- [get_dataset_info](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/get_dataset_info.html): Get metadata about a dataset
- [gnutella](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/gnutella.html): Gnutella peer-to-peer network snapshot
- [internet](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/internet.html): Internet Autonomous Systems network
- [jazz](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/jazz.html): Jazz musicians collaboration network
- [karate_club](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/karate_club.html): Zachary's Karate Club network
- [list_available_datasets](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/list_available_datasets.html): List all available dataset files in the data directory
- [list_registered_datasets](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/list_registered_datasets.html): List all registered datasets with metadata
- [load_dataset](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/load_dataset.html): Load a dataset by name from the data directory
- [pgp](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/pgp.html): PGP web of trust network
- [physics](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/physics.html): High Energy Physics - Phenomenology collaboration network
- [polbooks](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/polbooks.html): Political books network
- [power_grid](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/power_grid.html): US Power Grid network
- [soc_livejournal](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/soc_livejournal.html): LiveJournal social network
- [web_google](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/web_google.html): Google web graph (released 2002)
- [wiki_vote](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/wiki_vote.html): Wikipedia adminship voting network
- [from_matrix_market](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/from_matrix_market.html): Create a graph from a Matrix Market coordinate format file
- [tbl_centrality](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/tbl_centrality.html): Create a table of centrality measures for all nodes
- [tbl_network_summary](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/tbl_network_summary.html): Create a publication-ready summary table of network statistics
- [plot_graph](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/plot_graph.html): Render graph using WebGL (deck.gl-style approach)
- [graph_widget](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/graph_widget.html): Create an interactive graph widget
- [from_networkx](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/from_networkx.html): Convert a NetworkX graph to an EdgeCase Graph
- [to_networkx](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/to_networkx.html): Convert an EdgeCase Graph to a NetworkX graph
- [from_igraph](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/from_igraph.html): Convert an igraph graph to an EdgeCase Graph
- [to_igraph](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/to_igraph.html): Convert an EdgeCase Graph to an igraph graph
- [from_adjacency_matrix](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/from_adjacency_matrix.html): Create an EdgeCase Graph from an adjacency matrix
- [to_adjacency_matrix](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/reference/to_adjacency_matrix.html): Convert an EdgeCase Graph to an adjacency matrix
